newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups AsiaSat EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill ups AsiaSat EPS.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had raised its 1997 and 1998 profit forecasts for Asia Satellite Telecommunications Holdings Ltd and raised its year-end valuation to HK$22.97 per share from HK$22.29 per share.

In a recent report, Merrill Lynch said it had revised its 1997 net profit forecast for AsiaSat to HK$464 million, up from a previous forecast of HK$459 million, and earnings per share to HK$1.19 from HK$1.18.
It expected 1998 net income of HK$576 million against a previous estimate of HK$547 million.
AsiaSat reported 1996 net profit of HK$394.8 million and earnings per share of HK$1.01.
"We have assumed that transponder lease rate escalation averages five percent/year instead of three percent/year previously," Merrill Lynch said.

It also expected customers to move to Asiasat 3 from Asiasat 1 in 1998 instead of the year 2000, bringing the utilisation rate on Asiasat 3 to 85 percent rather than a previous estimate of 10 percent and the utilisation rate on Asiasat 1 to 10 percent rather than 90 percent in 1998.

"We expect announcements of additional lease commitments on Asiasat 3...to provide further catalysts for the company's stock price. This should also enhance the company's ability to achieve our revenue and profit projections," Merrill Lynch said.
AsiaSat shares were steady at HK$19.40 in Friday morning trade.
